name: Settings Page - Core Modules Verification
description: Verifies that AI Auto-Pilot section, Smart Automation block with 5 toggles, and Developer Settings area all render correctly on the WhatsAppBrain dashboard settings page.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Settings page
Wait for page to fully load
Verify the Settings page header is visible
Verify the AI Auto-Pilot section is rendered
Verify the Auto-Reply toggle label is present in AI Auto-Pilot
Verify the Smart Handoff toggle label is present in AI Auto-Pilot
Verify the AI Fallback toggle label is present in AI Auto-Pilot
Verify toggle switches are rendered as accessible switch elements in AI Auto-Pilot (3 toggles expected)
Verify the Smart Automation section is rendered
Verify toggle 1: Auto Profile Generation is present in Smart Automation
Verify toggle 2: Smart Pricing Suggestions is present in Smart Automation
Verify toggle 3: Auto Rule Generation is present in Smart Automation
Verify toggle 4: Sentiment Analysis is present in Smart Automation
Verify toggle 5: Smart Scheduling is present in Smart Automation
Verify the Developer Settings expandable section header is visible
Click to expand the Developer Settings section
Verify WhatsApp Access Token field is visible after expanding Developer Settings
Verify Phone Number ID field is visible in Developer Settings
Verify Webhook Verify Token field is visible in Developer Settings
Verify Resend API Key field is visible in Developer Settings
Toggle Smart Handoff off to verify toggle interaction works
Verify the Smart Handoff toggle is now in the OFF state
Toggle Smart Handoff back on
Verify the Smart Handoff toggle is now in the ON state
Capture final screenshot of the fully verified settings page
